mapper.insert: insert into gt_project (project_key, name, year_label, dataset_key, version_label, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{projectKey}, #{name}, #{yearLabel}, #{datasetKey}, #{versionLabel}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select * from gt_project order by id desc
